lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. What you’re describing is a real safety concern, and you deserve help right now. Please stay with me and reach a live crisis counselor now. If at any point you feel you might act on these thoughts, call nine one one immediately. For this moment, can you tell me where you are right now so we can keep you safe?
